source_rules.graph: Plant one of 3 colors for each vertex; for each vertex require >=1 and <=1 assigned color; sample unique edges only between different planted colors; for each edge forbid same color at endpoints. Complete planted color assignment must satisfy every original CNF clause.
source_rules.exactone: Plant one of five time slots per task; each task has at least-one + all pairwise at-most-one clauses; add consecutive tasks distinct-slot forbidden-pair clauses where planted slot differs. Distinct from planted random3SAT and E8's width3 random XOR generator.
source_rules.guarded_width4: Plant n-bit assignment; sample distinct width4 XOR supports; encode each as all eight forbidden parity assignments (eight exact width4 source-CNF clauses). Add fixed count of unique 3-clauses satisfied by plant; width4 differs from E8 mixed width3 though related parity theme.
source_rules.exact_DIMACS_SHA_and_planted_model_SHA: computed deterministically by preflight before any worker starts, pinned in immutable model-bound source manifest artifact; no source replacement and no second seed search

frozen_ood_gate.feature_basis: original E9 first128 source-only five cheap features, no SAT results or generator labels
frozen_ood_gate.positive_label_requirements: original E9 model: nearest group XOR and 4/4 previous verified native SAT; distance<=1.75
frozen_ood_gate.new_predeclared_extra_restrictions: positive nearest-vs-negative training distance margin >=0.50, feature vector inside union axis-aligned E8 training min/max plus fixed 0.25 tolerance each dimension; otherwise SKIP_SCAN_RAW

validation.complete_pair_ratios: Only same-host same-source both verified SAT; never compute censored ratio
validation.grouped_uncertainty: Family-level, only 3 families with 2 planted sources each; underpowered; no population 95pct bound claims
validation.OOD_detection: descriptive number abstained, near-positive and unknown errors; no posthoc parameter change
validation.falsification: abstention can yield no positive admissions or no net improvement; record zero
